Kaş Paragliding Experience

Staying in Kaş? You're just 2 hours from the world's best paragliding at Ölüdeniz. The perfect day trip from the Lycian Coast.

Paragliding Near Kaş: Your Best Option

Kaş is one of the most beautiful towns on Turkey's Lycian Coast, famous for scuba diving and its charming old quarter. While Kaş has a small local paragliding operation (low altitude, short flights), the real deal is a 2-hour drive east at Babadağ Mountain in Ölüdeniz.

The difference? Babadağ launches from 1,960m (vs. ~600m near Kaş), giving you a 25-45 minute flight over the legendary Blue Lagoon — one of the most photographed coastlines on Earth.

Getting from Kaş to Ölüdeniz

  • Our Day Trip: Pickup at 07:00, flight at 09:30, free time at Blue Lagoon, back in Kaş by 14:00.
  • Self-Drive: Follow the D400 east through Kalkan and Fethiye (2h). Stunning Lycian Coast road.
  • Dolmuş: Kaş → Fethiye bus (₺150, 2.5h), then Fethiye → Ölüdeniz minibus (₺30, 20min).
